QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Sun-Scorched Obelisk
QuestInfo.1: Ariant's guard, Tigun told you about the strange phenomenon in the Wasteland. What's going on? Go to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k by choosing #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror Portal#k.
QuestInfo.2: You came upon the Cygnus Knights where you arrived. What are they doing here?

0.0: Hey, did you hear the rumor? The one about the Wasteland at the end of the desert west of Ariant? They say once you go in, you can never come back...
0.1: I've heard there were huge clouds of sand and mammoth shadows stretching out over the Wasteland... the size of a building! And they say shadows of the dead walk around, just waiting to grab unsuspecting travelers! Aren't you curious?

yes.0: I knew you would be! You're the kind of adventurer that'll trek right into that Wasteland and find out what's going on! You can select #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror Portal#k and go all the way to #bAzwan Obelisk#k. Come back... if you can!

no.0: Oh, you're not? Man, I thought that was a pretty good story.

1.0: I did not expect to find anyone in this barren place. Have you come to help our Cygnus Knights? We are lacking sorely in resources. No one could have guessed we would find an entire underground city in the Obelisk.

npc.0: I thought you were all 'hooray' and 'let's go into the desert on a whim.' Just take the Dimensional Mirror Portal.
